decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) an abrupt, large-magnitude negative spike in N/E around index 520–525 with incomplete recovery, and (2) a clear onset of coherent linear trends in all axes starting at index 725, persisting to the end of record. Other features appear consistent with noise or smooth secular motion.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample negative spike in N and E (≈−6 MAD) at index ~520–525, followed by a rapid recovery; U shows a smaller concurrent dip. The event is abrupt and isolated, with no clear opposing return in the immediate aftermath—only gradual reversion toward baseline noise level.

Sustained linear trend in all three axes from ~725 onward: N drops steadily (~−0.2 MAD/day), E rises (~+0.15 MAD/day), U drops sharply (~−0.8 MAD/day). The onset is abrupt at index 725 (visible across overlapping windows), suggesting a possible step or onset of new motion regime; no return observed within window.
